title.original: MCPZoo: A Large-Scale Dataset of Runnable Model Context Protocol Servers for AI Agent
title.zh: MCPZoo：面向AI 智能体的可运行模型上下文协议服务器的大规模数据集
title.en: MCPZoo: A Large-Scale Dataset of Runnable Model Context Protocol Servers for AI Agent

inclusion_reason.zh: MCPZoo 的多源采集、去重、容器部署和交互验证提供可直接实验的大规模 Server 数据与运行基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: MCPZoo's multi-source ingestion, deduplication, container deployment, and interaction validation provide large-scale server data and runnable experimental infrastructure.

abstract.zh: MCPZoo 汇聚大规模 MCP Server，并实际部署验证其中可运行子集，提供统一元数据和访问接口用于系统与安全实验。
abstract.en: MCPZoo aggregates a large MCP-server corpus and deploys a verified runnable subset, exposing normalized metadata and access interfaces for systems and security experiments.

problem.zh: MCP 实证研究缺少可访问、可执行的大样本，研究者从分散市场手工部署 Server 成本高且难以复现。
problem.en: Empirical MCP research lacks a large accessible executable sample, and manually deploying servers from scattered markets is costly and irreproducible.

approach.zh: 作者从多源收集、去重 Server，统一描述信息，并通过部署与交互探针确认可运行实例后纳入开放数据集。
approach.en: Servers are collected from multiple sources, deduplicated, normalized, and admitted to an open runnable subset after deployment and interaction probes.

system_design.zh: 数据工厂包含采集连接器、实体解析、容器化部署、健康/交互验证、元数据仓库和统一实验访问 API。
system_design.en: The data factory combines source connectors, entity resolution, containerized deployment, health/interaction validation, a metadata store, and common experimental APIs.

key_results.zh: MCPZoo 从十万量级原始 Server 中识别数万独立项目，并提供上万已部署可交互实例，显著降低运行实验门槛。
key_results.en: MCPZoo resolves tens of thousands of distinct projects from a much larger raw corpus and provides many thousands of deployed interactive instances, lowering experiment setup cost.

limitations.zh: “可运行”不等于安全、正确或长期维护；公开 Server 会快速漂移，批量执行未知代码也需要持续供应链隔离和来源审计。
limitations.en: Runnable does not mean safe, correct, or maintained; public servers drift rapidly, and executing unknown code requires continuous supply-chain isolation and provenance review.

workloads: MCP server deployment and interaction validation

metrics.name: Deployed and verified runnable server instances

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
